properties.comment: If you are experiencing an outage please call 1-800-900-2832 and ask to speak with a dispatcher.  We need to confirm details or your outage prior to dispatching a crew.

Crews will need to go back to the yard and bring the mule back to the location in order to patrol a section of line that is currently not accessible with the service vehicles from the recent heavy rains. Addtional updates will be provided as quickly as possible.
